description: Roadmap placeholder for the canonical worked example in docs/design-quality-standard.md: a reference photo of a pig turned into a polished, gift-worthy piggy bank - not a blobby image-to-3D pass. No CAD, mesh, or render exists for this concept.
backend_gate_status: not_implemented - requires future Blender local-automation phase and/or a Meshy safety/cost approval gate before any generation may occur

design_intent.audience_or_user: gift recipient or self - a desk/shelf piggy bank
design_intent.use_case: everyday coin storage that's also a display-worthy object

reference_inputs.description: a reference photo of a pig, used only for style/silhouette inspiration

visual_goals.silhouette: instantly reads as a pig from any angle, not just head-on
visual_goals.proportions: rounded, friendly, not anatomically literal - toy-like
visual_goals.surface_detail: smooth, ceramic-like finish; no visible generation artifacts
visual_goals.color_material_intent: single-color body, TBD - human decision before generation

functional_goals.primary_function: hold and store coins, retrievable later
functional_goals.tension_or_flex_notes: not applicable - rigid body, no flexing parts

iteration_plan.prototype_strategy: review a low-detail blockout for silhouette/proportions before any surface detail pass
iteration_plan.acceptance_notes: polished and gift-worthy, not blobby - matches docs/design-quality-standard.md's piggy bank example in full

notes: This file uses `concept_brief.json`, not `brief.json`, so `factory` commands do not treat this directory as a real, in-progress project.
No STL, render, or other generated mesh asset exists for this concept.
This concept is not human_approved and not print_ready, and is not expected to pass factory review-gate.
Meshy remains disabled by default - see docs/meshy-approval-gate.md and config/future_cloud_tools.json (factory check-future-tools).
Blender remains future-only with no automation - see docs/blender-local-track.md and config/future_local_tools.json (factory check-local-tools).
The goal is a staged design workflow ending in a polished, gift-worthy piggy bank - not a single-shot 'picture to blob' generation.
design_intent is planning-only (see docs/design-intent-brief.md, Phase 24) - it is not read or validated by any factory command and never sets human_approved or print_ready.
